messages:
nina: Quick sync from the postmortem. We still have open remediation items around GPU headroom and autoscaler behavior. Can we confirm owners + short deadlines?

jamal: I can take the headroom simulation + heatmap dashboards. Plan: baseline replay -> +10%, +20%, +30% demand legs. ETA for first replay = 72h.

sophia: I'll own scheduler changes (binpacking tweaks + preempt thresholds). Will push a draft config by Mon and run a focused 24h soak.

mohit: I'll handle quota policy + procurement liaison. Current ask from SRE: set provisional target headroom=22% until tests prove otherwise. Is that acceptable?

carla: filed a quick tracker row: https://go.redwood/incident-1999. Added columns: owner, due, verification. Also uploaded the postmortem link.

nina: jamal, can you scope the replay to include tail 99.9% latency measurement? We care about tail for small LLM runs.

jamal: yep. replay will emit p50/p95/p99/p999. Also will tag by zone and GPU family.

ops-bot: [auto] Created task INC-1999-01: Headroom simulation (owner=jamal) due=2026-04-08.

ops-bot: [auto] Created task INC-1999-02: Scheduler config draft (owner=sophia) due=2026-04-06.

mohit: procurement note: any reserved capacity increase >12% requires finance signoff. For test runs we can provision short-term burst credits. I'll request temporary quota today.

carla: added a PagerDuty alert: tail-utilization-warning (PD-1032). Trigger when GPU tail > 78% for 2h across any one zone.

jamal: quick infra ask: need a staging cluster with the same scheduler version and GPU drivers. @carla can you request cluster?

carla: done. cluster request ticket #CL-442. Expected ready in 10h. I'll post kubeconfig link in tracker when ready.

sophia: scheduler draft (snippet) below - trying a conservative change first. Will log full diff in the tracker.

```
# scheduler patch
binpackScoreWeight: 1.2
preemptionGracePeriodSeconds: 30
evictLowerPriority: true
schedulerBurstWindowMs: 25
```

mohit: for cost evals: jamal please capture aggregate GPU-hours and estimate $$$ delta for the 30-day projection. We'll need that for the finance approval.

jamal: will include cost projection. also plan to run two replay windows separated by 24h to catch diurnal effects.

nina: ownership summary: jamal=headroom sims + dashboards, sophia=scheduler tuning + tests, mohit=quota/procurement/cost, carla=tracker+alerts. deadlines: sophia Mon, jamal 72h, mohit confirm temp quota by EOD, carla cluster in 10h.

carla: ops-bot created a recurring weekly check: HEADROOM-REVIEW, every Mon for 8 weeks. ops-bot: recurrence ID R-1999-WK.

ops-bot: [auto] Created recurring task R-1999-WK: Weekly headroom review. Next run=2026-04-06.

mohit: finance approved short-term burst for testing. Formal capacity changes will follow after two successful validations + cost estimate.

jamal: will post initial replay graphs to tracker and add a short write-up of methodology.

sophia: if scheduler changes reduce tail latency by >15% without raising cost >8% then we can promote to canary. Otherwise we'll iterate.

nina: please document the canary rollback steps in the runbook. I want someone assigned to execute rollback during the canary window.

carla: noted. added rollback runbook link in tracker and assigned a responsible on-call. Also scheduled a 30m check-in for after the first canary run.

ops-bot: [reminder] Meeting: Headroom follow-up check-in -> 2026-04-09 15:00 UTC. Reminder 30m before.

nina: thanks all. We'll use this thread to capture quick updates; major status in the tracker. Reconvene Friday if we have replay results.
